name: Abirama Putra
bio:
Abirama Putra Andresta is an Indonesian actor, artist, and filmmaker based in Jakarta. He began his career at a young age through theater, modeling, and commercial work before moving into film and television.

Abirama made his feature-film debut in Wiro Sableng: 212 Warrior and has since appeared in a range of Indonesian film and television productions, including Gundala, Affliction, Motel Melati, Janji Darah, Sumala, and Garuda: Dare to Dream. His work spans drama, horror, action, and family-oriented productions. (The Jakarta Post⁠￼)

Alongside acting, Abirama is developing himself as a multidisciplinary artist and filmmaker, exploring film, visual art, and creative projects. His artistic interests extend beyond performance, with a focus on creating and developing his own work and visual language.

As an emerging Indonesian artist, Abirama continues to work across acting and independent creative projects while developing his practice as a filmmaker and multidisciplinary artist.
